statement.p: Match the following concepts with the correct definitions:

li.p: f is a one-to-one function from {\mathbb R}^3 to {\mathbb R}^3
f is an onto function from {\mathbb R}^3 to {\mathbb R}^3
f is a function from {\mathbb R}^3 to {\mathbb R}^3
For every y\in {\mathbb R}^3, there is a x\in {\mathbb R}^3 such that f(x)=y.
For every x\in {\mathbb R}^3, there is a y\in {\mathbb R}^3 such that f(x)=y.
For every y\in {\mathbb R}^3, there is a unique x\in {\mathbb R}^3 such that f(x)=y.
For every y \in {\mathbb R}^3, there is at most one x\in {\mathbb R}^3 such that f(x)=y.
